jobs.title: Generative AI Producer (Creative)
jobs.description:
Generative AI Producer (Creative)
5+ Month W2 Contract


San Jose, CA preferred, or Remote (US)


Here's how you'll become a key player with this opportunity:


We're seeking a highly creative Generative AI Producer who can produce email content, video, static images, music/audio, text, and other modalities using the latest generative AI models. You'll translate creative direction and performance feedback into high‑quality, on‑brand assets, rapidly iterate variations, and build repeatable workflows that scale output while preserving craft quality.


Here’s how you’ll make an impact on the team:



Create multimodal content (video, images, text, music), combining tools and techniques to ship campaign‑ready assets at high velocity.
Prototype and iterate quickly including generative ai tools - generate many variants, work with marketers to run controlled experiments, and select winners based on creative judgment and performance metrics (e.g., engagement, CTR, conversion).
Integrate feedback from marketing performance data; synthesize notes into precise prompts, control signals, or edits to improve output quality.
Guardrails & rights: apply brand, safety, accessibility, and data/IP usage policies; ensure licensing and attribution are respected across assets.
Stay current: track state‑of‑the‑art models and releases; recommend adoption paths and evaluate trade‑offs (quality, latency, cost, licensing).
Light post‑production as needed: compositing, color, audio mixing, subtitles/captions, and format adaptation across channels.

Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

BS, BA or MS preferred
Hands‑on portfolio spanning multiple modalities (links or reels). Show your prompt craft, references you used, and final outcomes.
Production‑grade proficiency with leading generative models and control tools (text‑to‑X, image‑to‑X, video‑to‑X, audio‑to‑X), including techniques like image conditioning, keyframing/controls, masking, in/out‑painting, and style/character consistency.
Workflow & scripting aptitude for repeatability (e.g., prompt templating, API use, or node/graph UIs).
Creative fundamentals: composition, lighting, motion, typography, sound design, storytelling.
Data‑informed creativity: familiarity with A/B testing, marketing KPIs, and how creative choices influence performance.
Content governance: understanding of usage rights, licensing, and brand/safety guidelines for AI‑generated media.

Pay Range: 
$75.00 - $82.39/hour


Benefits That Matter to You: 



NextDeavor offers health, vision and dental benefits for contract employees
Paid sick leave eligibility is contingent on state of residence
Optional 401k Plan (excludes employer match)

jobs.title: Remote | Brand & Creative Strategy Specialist (Marketing Collateral) — $70–$110/hour
jobs.description:
We are sharing a specialised part-time consulting opportunity for experienced brand, creative direction, and marketing professionals with strong expertise in brand strategy, visual communication, creative development, and marketing collateral.

This role focuses on reviewing professional documents, spreadsheets, and presentation materials related to branding, creative direction, and marketing. Selected experts will assess outputs for strategic alignment, brand consistency, creative quality, factual accuracy, visual effectiveness, and overall professional credibility.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Positioning


Evaluate brand strategies, positioning materials, and related work products for quality and consistency

Assess whether messaging and creative recommendations align with stated brand objectives

Review brand narratives, value propositions, and audience positioning

Identify inconsistencies, unsupported assumptions, and weaknesses in brand logic

Apply professional judgement grounded in real-world brand strategy experience
Creative Direction


Review creative concepts, campaign materials, and visual communication approaches

Assess whether creative execution appropriately reflects brand identity and intended objectives

Evaluate visual hierarchy, consistency, clarity, and overall creative quality

Identify weak concepts, inconsistent execution, and aesthetic issues

Review whether creative recommendations are practical and professionally credible
Marketing Collateral


Evaluate brochures, presentations, campaign materials, sales collateral, and other marketing assets

Assess content structure, messaging, visual presentation, and audience relevance

Review consistency of branding, terminology, claims, and key messages

Identify factual, editorial, visual, or formatting issues

Evaluate whether collateral communicates its intended message clearly and effectively
Brand Identity & Consistency


Review materials for consistency with established brand positioning and visual standards

Assess use of messaging, tone, typography, layouts, and other brand elements

Identify inconsistencies across related documents and presentations

Evaluate whether different materials form a coherent brand experience

Review alignment between strategic intent and creative execution
Marketing & Audience Communication


Evaluate materials intended for customers, prospects, partners, or other audiences

Assess whether messaging is clear, persuasive, relevant, and appropriately structured

Review audience targeting and communication priorities

Identify confusing, unsupported, or ineffective messaging

Evaluate whether creative and marketing choices support the intended communication objective
Documents & Presentation Review


Evaluate brand and marketing documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks for accuracy and completeness

Review presentations for narrative flow, visual hierarchy, clarity, and professional polish

Identify factual, aesthetic, editorial, and formatting errors

Assess whether charts, tables, graphics, and other visual elements communicate information effectively

Ensure key messages and recommendations are clearly presented
Structured Evaluation & Feedback


Assess assigned outputs against domain-specific quality criteria

Identify strategic, creative, factual, aesthetic, and presentation weaknesses

Distinguish substantive brand or creative issues from minor production concerns

Provide clear, structured written feedback explaining identified strengths and weaknesses

Apply evaluation standards consistently across different brand and marketing work products
Ideal Profile

5+ years of relevant professional experience in brand strategy, creative direction, marketing, brand management, creative strategy, or a closely related field

Experience as a Brand Manager, Creative Director, Marketing Manager, Brand Strategist, Creative Strategist, or similar professional

Strong practical understanding of brand strategy, creative direction, and marketing collateral
Experience developing or reviewing brand materials, marketing campaigns, presentations, creative concepts, or customer-facing collateral

Strong visual judgement and ability to assess brand consistency and creative quality

Highly proficient with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
Advanced proficiency with PowerPoint / Google Slides
Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills

Native or professional fluency in English
Excellent written communication and ability to provide precise, structured feedback

Strong attention to strategic, creative, visual, and presentation detail

Master's degree or higher from a recognised institution is advantageous
Engagement Details


Part-time independent contractor engagement

Fully remote

Flexible scheduling based on project requirements
Compensation: $70–$110/hour
Work includes evaluation of brand strategies, creative materials, marketing collateral, documents, spreadsheets, and presentation materials

Projects may be extended, shortened, or concluded based on project needs and performance

Work must be completed without using confidential or proprietary information belonging to any employer, client, institution, or other third party

H1-B and STEM OPT support is unavailable for this engagement
About the Platform

This opportunity is available through 24-MAG LLC. We connect experienced professionals with remote consulting opportunities across technical, evaluation, and project-based workstreams.

By submitting this application, you acknowledge that your information may be processed by 24-MAG LLC for recruitment and opportunity matching in accordance with our Privacy Policy: https://www.24-mag.com/privacy-policy.


Remote
